terms.general_body: Welcome to the New Singapur Telecom website. By using this website, you are deemed to accept our terms and conditions and privacy policy.
terms.stock_body: Product stock shown on the website is synced with our live POS system. If a product goes out of stock for any reason, our support team will contact the buyer within 24 hours.
terms.cod_body: For cash on delivery orders, our own delivery charge of ৳200 is added to the order automatically. The full amount must be paid to the courier agent when the product is received.

privacy.collection_body: We collect your name, phone number, email and delivery address to create your customer portal account and make checkout easier.
privacy.protection_body: Your personal information is stored encrypted and highly secured in our database. Your information is never sold or transferred to any third party or outside organization.

refund.replacement_body: All our original and used devices come with a 7-day replacement facility (in case of any manufacturing defect or hardware fault).
refund.condition_body: To process a refund or return, the original cash memo, box and all included accessories must be returned to our showroom in intact condition.

emi.easy_body: New Singapur Telecom offers 0% EMI installments through 24 leading banks in Bangladesh. Installments can be activated for 3, 6, 9 and 12 month terms.
emi.fee_body: Depending on the bank's rules, a processing or conversion fee may apply based on the EMI term, which will be shown on the payment checkout page.
